stages.title: Ground-floor ICF

stages.title: First-floor steel and hollowcore
stages.desc: S-101 first-floor steel cast into and bearing on the ground-floor ICF, the posts and connections, and the 150 hollowcore floor.

stages.title: First-floor ICF
stages.desc: First-floor ICF walls on the ground-floor ICF and the hollowcore, with their openings.

stages.title: Second-floor steel and joists
stages.desc: S-102 second-floor steel on the first-floor ICF and the posi / C24 joists between the steel.

stages.title: Roof steel, timbers and stair
stages.desc: S-103 roof steel (mansard frames, purlins, gable rafters and ridges), the roof timbers and the main stair.
